questions.question: P, Q, R, and S are respectively the mid-points of the sides AB, BC, CD, and DA of a quadrilateral ABCD. If AC = BD and AC is perpendicular to BD, prove that PQRS is a square.
questions.finalAnswer: Proven using mid-point properties and diagonal relations.
solutionSteps: PQRS is a parallelogram with sides parallel to diagonals AC and BD.
Side PQ = 1/2 AC and PS = 1/2 BD. Since AC = BD, PQ = PS (Rhombus property).
Since PQ || AC and PS || BD, and AC ⊥ BD, it follows that PQ ⊥ PS (Angle = 90°).
A rhombus with a right angle is a square.

questions.question: In a parallelogram ABCD, the bisector of Angle A meets DC at E. AE and BC produced meet at F. If AB = 10 cm and AD = 6 cm, find the length of CF.
solutionSteps: Since AE bisects A, ∠DAE = ∠BAE.
Since AD || BF, ∠DAE = ∠F (Alternate angles). So ∠BAE = ∠F.
In ΔABF, since angles at A and F are equal, side AB = BF = 10 cm.
BF = BC + CF. Since BC = AD = 6 cm, 10 = 6 + CF.
CF = 4 cm.

questions.question: ABCD is a trapezium in which AB || DC and AD = BC. Prove that Angle A = Angle B and Angle C = Angle D.
questions.finalAnswer: Proven using construction of parallel line.
solutionSteps: Draw CE || AD meeting AB extended at E. ADCE is a parallelogram.
So AD = CE. Since AD = BC, CE = BC. In ΔBCE, ∠CBE = ∠CEB.
∠A + ∠CEB = 180 (Co-interior). ∠ABC + ∠CBE = 180 (Linear pair).
Since CEB = CBE, ∠A = ∠ABC (or ∠B).
Since A+D = 180 and B+C = 180, and A=B, then D=C.

questions.question: Show that the line segments joining the mid-points of the opposite sides of a quadrilateral bisect each other.
questions.finalAnswer: Proven by showing PQRS is a parallelogram.
solutionSteps: Let P, Q, R, S be midpoints of sides AB, BC, CD, DA.
By Mid-point Theorem, PQ || AC || SR and PQ = 1/2 AC = SR.
Since one pair of opposite sides is equal and parallel, PQRS is a parallelogram.
The diagonals of PQRS (PR and SQ) are the segments in question. Diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other.

questions.question: In a parallelogram ABCD, E and F are mid-points of AB and CD. Show that the line segments AF and EC trisect the diagonal BD.
solutionSteps: AECF is a parallelogram (AE=CF, AE||CF). So AF || EC.
In ΔDQC (Q on BD), F is mid of DC and FP || CQ. So P is mid of DQ => DP = PQ.
In ΔABP (P on BD), E is mid of AB and EQ || AP. So Q is mid of BP => PQ = QB.
Combining, DP = PQ = QB. BD is trisected.
